subject: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Santos <daniel.santos@elloway.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Elloway_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a condensed list of milestones with owner suggestions. High-level asks in this note: please confirm the proposed go-live target (Aug 12), the project sponsor for weekly check-ins, and whether procurement needs a separate signature path for our standard MSA.

Summary (proposed):
- Kickoff / Technical scoping: Jun 21 (30–45m) — Owner: Marissa (CS Tech Lead)
- Integration sprint 1 (inbound routing + auth): Jun 24–Jul 12 — Owner: Priyom (Solutions Eng)
- Validation / UAT: Jul 15–Jul 26 — Owner: Naomi (Onboarding)
- Production readiness review & final docs: Aug 5–Aug 9 — Owners: Ben + Naomi
- Go-live: Aug 12 (target)

Risks we flagged: SOC2 evidence for data handling, and a short window for UAT if integrations slip. If you prefer an earlier scoping slot I can push things tighter; alternatively we can move go-live +2 weeks.

Action items for Elloway: confirm sponsor, confirm availability for Jun 21 scoping (we'll propose two times), and confirm whether procurement wants redlines in DocuSign (we can route to your procurement alias).

Attached: Elloway_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, milestone sheet + owner tab).

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Elloway_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet: milestones)
From: Daniel Santos <daniel.santos@elloway.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@elloway.com>, Elloway Procurement <procurement@elloway.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the summary and the MAP. Quick notes from our side:
- Sponsor: Asha Iyer (VP Product) will own weekly check-ins.
- Jun 21 scoping: Asha is only available in the afternoon; can Marissa do 3:30pm PT?
- Procurement: please route the MSA to procurement@elloway.com. They need SOC2 in addition to our standard security pack before legal signs.
- Go-live: Aug 12 is tight given other commitments; we'd prefer Aug 26 if that doesn't materially impact your engineering scheduling.

Also copying procurement for any required paperwork. We'll review the MAP and come back with minor date suggestions by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Platform Ops — Elloway Technologies
Daniel.Santos@elloway.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Elloway Procurement <procurement@elloway.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2024 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence

Thanks Daniel — noted and updated assumptions below. Marissa: can you take the 3:30pm PT scoping on Jun 21? Naomi/Priyom: marking the UAT window with a one-week buffer if they confirm Aug 26.

Adjusted plan (draft):
- Kickoff / Technical scoping: Jun 21, 15:30 PT — Owner: Marissa Cole
- Integration sprint 1: Jun 24–Jul 12 — Owner: Priyom Das
- Integration sprint 2: Jul 15–Aug 2 — Owner: Priyom / Elloway dev lead
- Validation / UAT: Aug 5–Aug 16 (two-week window) — Owner: Naomi Feldman
- Readiness review: Aug 19–Aug 23 — Owners: Ben + Naomi
- Go-live: Aug 26 (confirmed tentative)

Notes on procurement and SOC2: Naomi, can you share the standard SOC2 evidence bundle link and a short checklist (we should expect the procurement team to ask for encryption-at-rest details, data retention policy, and logging/audit exports). I'll route DocuSign to procurement@elloway.com and include a fallback reviewer for legal.

If Asha confirms the sponsor and Jun 21 15:30 works, we'll send calendar invites and an agenda (30m tech scoping + 15m for procurement/legal intro).

Thanks — I'll update the Drive MAP and push a version with the schedule (Elloway_MAP_v1.1).

Best,
Ben

> > ...Quick notes from our side...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2024 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence

Hi all —

I can take the Jun 21 15:30 PT scoping slot. Proposed agenda for 30–45m:
- 0–5m: Introductions + success criteria (Asha)
- 5–15m: Auth & network (Priyom covers required headers, IP allowlist, and token flow)
- 15–30m: Integration surface (Elloway dev lead + Priyom)
- 30–40m: UAT approach & acceptance criteria (Naomi)
- 40–45m: Next steps, calendar invites, and DocuSign owner (Ben)

Prep for our side: Priyom will build a short staging runbook (server endpoints, test accounts, sample payloads), Naomi will draft a one-page acceptance checklist that lines up with your internal QA. Daniel/Asha: please confirm your dev lead and whether you need VPN or VPC peering for staging.

I'll send the invite with a Zoom link and the agenda after confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
CS Technical Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Santos <daniel.santos@elloway.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2024 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elloway transition plan: MAP, milestones, and handoff cadence

Daniel / Asha —

Thanks for confirming the sponsor and the Aug 26 target. I've attached a short acceptance criteria doc (Acceptance-Criteria.docx) that we'll use for the UAT sign-off. Highlights:
- Core success criteria: 95% response rate under SLA for canonical flows, auth verified, no PII leaks in logs.
- UAT plan: smoke tests (2 days), regression (5 days), stakeholder demo (1 day).
- Cutover checklist: backup snapshot, rollback play, and runbook owner assigned.

Procurement: Ben will route the DocuSign envelope; procurement@elloway.com please confirm the SOC2 elements you need so we can attach the evidence bundle.

Next steps (actionable):
- Ben: Share Elloway_MAP_v1.1 link + send calendar invites for Jun 21 15:30 PT.
- Marissa: Share Zoom invite and staging runbook draft by Jun 18.
- Priyom: Draft staging endpoints and sample payloads by Jun 17.
- Daniel/Asha: Confirm dev lead and procurement reviewer by Jun 17.

I'll be tracking acceptance in the MAP and will publish the UAT sign-off doc in the Drive link Ben provided.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
